name: youtube-automation
description: Automated workflow for processing YouTube music mixes, including 9B model escalation and multi-track renaming.

process_youtube_mix.description: CRITICAL: The tool name is exactly 'process_youtube_mix'. A high-level automation tool that downloads a YouTube mix, splits it into tracks, and renames them using a provided artist name. Automatically handles model escalation to 9B if required.

url.description: The YouTube URL of the mix video.

artist.description: The name of the artist to use for renaming (e.g., '鄭中基').

expected_tracks.description: Optional: The number of songs expected in the mix (e.g., 20).
